title: EBS Volume IOPS Trend Baseline Deviation

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay or inject sample `aws:cloudwatch` events matching `*` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.6.9 search returns >=1 row and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:cloudwatch` traffic without `*` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:cloudwatch` collected via Splunk Add-on for AWS CloudWatch input; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.

index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudwatch"
| table _time metric_name namespace unit average maximum

description: Compares seven-day ebs volume iops trend against thirty-day baseline using CloudWatch-derived metrics.
value: Early capacity or abuse signals appear in ebs volume iops trend before hard limits.
implementation: Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudwatch.

knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for AWS CloudWatch input with the modular input for `aws:cloudwatch`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.6.7.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `metric_name` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:cloudwatch.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudwatch" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:cloudwatch"
| table _time metric_name namespace unit average maximum
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.6.9_ebs_volume_iops_trend_ba_9"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:cloudwatch` in `index=aws` to detect ebs volume iops trend baseline deviation. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Amazon CloudWatch console Metrics for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `metric_name` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_6_9_alert` with severity aligned to `medium` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for AWS CloudWatch input and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of ebs volume iops trend baseline deviation so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
